🎥🍿: The Nice Guys (2016)

A down-on-his-luck private investigator and a tough-for-hire enforcer are forced into an unlikely partnership after a missing girl and the mysterious death of a young woman lead them into the same investigation. As they dig deeper, they uncover a web of corruption involving powerful businessmen, government officials, and dangerous criminals.

Despite constantly clashing over their methods, the mismatched duo stumble through explosive shootouts, hilarious misunderstandings, and unexpected twists while trying to stay one step ahead of those determined to silence them. Their chaotic partnership slowly turns into an unlikely friendship built on survival and trust.

Blending sharp comedy, action, and mystery, The Nice Guys delivers a fast-paced detective story packed with memorable characters, witty banter, and surprising revelations set against the stylish backdrop of 1970s Los Angeles.

source_details.synopsis: The Nice Guys is a 2016 American neo-noir buddy action comedy film directed by Shane Black, who co-wrote the screenplay with Anthony Bagarozzi, produced by Joel Silver, and starring Russell Crowe and Ryan Gosling in the title roles, with Angourie Rice, Matt Bomer, Margaret Qualley, Keith David, and Kim Basinger appearing in supporting roles. Set in 1970s Los Angeles, the film focuses on private eye Holland March (Gosling) and enforcer for hire Jackson Healy (Crowe) who team up to investigate the disappearance of a teenage girl (Qualley).
